scope: tail attachment interpretation; not the complete skeletal or mesh topology

connections.region: rear midline at base of spine
upper tail fused directly at body

proposedSpatialInterpretation.tail-root: compact shared fusion at body; three tails separate immediately, with no projecting common trunk
